_comment: Effect vocabulary and parameter ranges — Requirements 29.1-29.8.
This file is the DSP worker's ONLY declaration of these numbers: effects.py loads it
rather than restating them, so the worker cannot drift from the product layer by
editing a constant. The TypeScript side declares the same table in
the two in both directions (every kind, every parameter name, every bound), so a
change on either side that is not mirrored here fails `npm test`.
It lives inside the Python package, not under domain/, so that it ships in the wheel
built by `pip install -e .` — a file under domain/ would be absent from an installed
Parameter names are pedalboard's keyword arguments, quoted verbatim from the
requirement text. effects.py splats them straight into the constructors, so there is
no name-mapping table to fall out of step.
extends_tail marks the two effects that can lengthen the signal (delay, reverb):
Requirement 29.30 exempts a chain containing either from length preservation, and
29.32 gives such a chain a 10-second tail allowance instead.
